---
name: Catalog or access correction
about: Report an issue without copying restricted source material
---

## Affected public area or record

Link the existing public record. Do not publish sensitive coordinates.

## Correction and source

Describe your original observation or link an authoritative notice. Do not paste copyrighted guidebook content or private correspondence.

## Dates

When was this observed? Does it apply to a specific interval?

## Effect on existing plans

Does this affect access, a trail, a climb, or attribution?
